title: Slow Through the Mist
logline: Fog comes down on a mountain railway until a driver and a signalman can see only a few metres of track, and the only way through is to slow to a walking pace and look.
human_question: When you cannot see where you are going, what does it take to keep moving safely?

situation.what_happens: On a steep mountain line cloud settles for hours at a time and visibility falls to a few metres. The staff have a procedure for exactly this: the train is taken at a crawl, the signalman works by token, bell and lamp instead of by sight, and each step is confirmed rather than assumed. Passengers see nothing but white through the windows. The fog lifts or it does not, and the work goes on either way.
situation.who_is_involved: A signalman at a mountain station, a driver and crew, the passengers carried through it, and the supervisors whose rules make the crawl compulsory.
situation.what_is_at_stake: Lives, plainly. Also the timetable, and the long patience of people whose work is to move something heavy through what cannot be seen.
situation.how_it_unfolds: It begins when the cloud arrives, continues through hours of slow confirmed steps, and ends when the weather changes or the shift does. The pressures are delay, cold, radio and telephone traffic, and the temptation to go faster. It ends with the valley appearing, or with the fog simply staying. Reality decides, and the film has to accept either.

concept_merge.why_together: C008 gives the state the whole group rests on: delusion is described as a quality that darkens the mind so it cannot know a thing as it is, and it is what both delusion-rooted minds share [C008-M:L3]; restlessness, the inability to hold one object, is the other half of the group's problem [C008-P:L62]. C074 gives the answer in the sources' own idiom: the states that cover the mind are met with strikingly ordinary helps, open air, the recollection of light, and calm [C074-P:L236; C074-P:L360; C074-P:L430–L436]. A crew whose real procedure is to slow down and confirm each step holds the state and the help in the same hour.
concept_merge.what_it_reveals: That the answer to not seeing is not certainty but pace. C008 alone would leave the group in the fog; C074 alone would make the helps sound like advice. Together they show that people already do this, and that moving carefully through what cannot be seen is an ordinary competence rather than a spiritual achievement.

concept_links.why: The digest gives delusion as the darkening that stops a mind knowing a thing as it is, present in all unwholesome minds and dominant in the two this group is built on [C008-M:L3], and gives restlessness as the loss of the power to stay with one object [C008-P:L62]. The fog is an image of that darkening and nothing more. The film is about the workers' real practice, and the digest's caution holds: slowing down is their safety procedure, not a technique the sources promise will clear delusion, which they say only path-knowledge uproots.

The compendium describes the hindrances as a lid over the mind and lists plain, practical helps against them: going out into the open air, recollecting light, keeping to what is calm and to good company [C074-P:L236; C074-P:L360; C074-P:L430–L436]. Signal lamps and slow, confirmed work can carry that without a word being said.

what_the_viewer_could_understand: When you cannot see far, the way through is to slow down and look carefully at what is right in front of you. The texts describe confusion as something that darkens the mind, and name calm as the opposite of restlessness.
what_must_be_real: The fog, the procedures and the journey. Nothing is slowed, repeated or arranged for the camera, and safety rules come before every shot.
position_hint: closing candidate: the group's closing line made literal, and the hand-off to what follows, which asks what we actually find when we look closely at a single moment.
risks: Scenic footage becoming a travel film.
The fog metaphor becoming too neat, and the workers becoming its illustration.
Suggesting that slowing down clears confusion; the sources say only path-knowledge uproots it.
Safety in poor visibility around moving trains.
drop_if: Close filming of the work cannot be permitted.
No fog days fall within the development window.

connections.note: The group opens on something covered by water and closes on something covered by cloud.
The scattered rush of the market resolves into work that can only be done slowly.
Two ways to close the group on close attention; one is held in reserve.

selection.reason: Carries the group's closing episode and turns the group from being lost to slowing down and looking.

unknowns: No participant or event has been found or confirmed. Everything here is a research direction.
evidence_class_note: Editorial proposal. No location, scene or shot decisions are made at the idea stage.
